observing.refusing: source hash and structural routing checks raise on instrument faults; recurrence or pattern-match failure is reported, never filtered
observing.recurrence: publicly indicated priors plus pending parities plus source positions; conditional on the stated source continuation
observing.status: executed finite constructions; no claim of arbitrary sequence learning or independently paced natural society
